description: A web service: a Fastify API and a Next.js web app in one repo, Zod 4 schemas in one shared folder, one database gateway, one error contract.

core.purpose: shared code the API and the web app both import

schemas.purpose: every Zod 4 schema: requests, responses, records, forms, the error contract

api.purpose: the Fastify API: buildServer(), env.ts, the error handler, plugins

routes.purpose: thin routes: method, path, schemas, one handler call

handlers.purpose: the work of each route, through adapters

adapters.purpose: the one database gateway and every other outside service

auth.purpose: authentication and the request's identity (the chain keys come from here)

web-app.purpose: the web app's routes: pages, layouts and their loading and error states (the App Router)

web-components.purpose: the web app's components, built from the one set of UI primitives

schema.what: a Zod schema (z.object) and the error contract

db-gateway.what: the database driver and its one gateway

api-test.what: API tests (inject(), never a bound port)

1: Put a database call outside the adapters, a Zod schema outside the schemas folder, or business rules in a route.
